claims.text: The driver's own trailing-30-day record trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming gate on BOTH limbs, so the rider's pattern concern is made out on the record: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, which is greater than 0.08. Under POL-NS-07 compensation to this driver must therefore be WITHHELD, no driver payment issues on this trip, and the case escalates under POL-NS-09, with the escalation packet carrying a direction to the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in full. That gate is reached precisely because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full on this trip and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it — so the fee is not resolved by the waiting-period arithmetic but by the driver's 30-day no-show pattern.

Escalation is mandatory, terminal, and leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge: POL-NS-09(d) fires because the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check trips, and POL-NS-09 provides that the disputed SGD 4.00 is placed ON HOLD rather than collected or refunded while human review is pending. POL-GEN-03 confirms that ESCALATE always replaces the monetary ruling, so the automated pipeline collects no fee from the rider in the meantime, and the rider is not left funding a dispute the platform has not resolved.

No escalation limb is engaged against the rider on her own record, and the rider's lifetime flag must not be read as abuse: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and the rider limb of POL-NS-09(d) are not triggered. The value of 1 in rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags is a LIFETIME counter, is not no_show_disputes_30d, and POL-GEN-01 forbids substituting it for the trailing-30-day figure that POL-NS-09(d) reads.

The rider does not press the waiting-period arithmetic, and says so plainly: the driver's own trace shows a single continuous in-geofence interval of 330 seconds against the 300-second minimum for this LARGE_VENUE pickup, so the shortfall basis is negative (-30 seconds) and POL-NS-06's strict-liability route gives the rider nothing on this record. Limb (i) accumulation is equally unavailable to either side — the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09108-01, is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and the rider asserts no limb (i) case. This dispute is therefore decided by the driver's pattern, not by a dwell shortfall.

The sum in issue is exactly SGD 4.00 and none of it has been returned to the rider: fare_breakdown itemises a single cancellation_fee line of 4.00 with total_charged 4.00, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and payment_status PENDING, and SGD 4.00 is the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00) for this trip. That is the figure the escalation packet must direct the reviewer to refund, and the figure that must be held rather than collected while review is pending.

POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are met on this record: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-08T09:30:20, and the GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence from its first fix at 09:30:00, twenty seconds before that event. Every one of the 34 driver fixes sits about 24 m from the PLQ pin, far inside the 120 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for a LARGE_VENUE zone.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met: the driver held position inside the geofence for a single continuous run of 330 seconds, from 09:30:00 to 09:35:30, which is 30 seconds longer than the 300-second minimum for a LARGE_VENUE pickup. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, exactly as limb (c) requires and not from the arrival tap, so the 20-second interval between the first fix and the 'arrived' event costs the driver nothing.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is met: the trip was terminated by the driver at 09:35:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, thirty seconds after the required 300-second dwell had elapsed, and the record shows no boarding event. All four limbs of the baseline chargeable no-show therefore hold.

The POL-NS-02 proximity test is satisfied on clean evidence: 34 driver fixes qualify inside the arrival radius, the driver's only distinct speed reading is 0.0 kph, and the trace is intact with 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. There is therefore no accuracy-filtering or sparsity objection available against the arrival.

POL-NS-05 does not touch this fee. At the 09:30:20 arrival event the driver was about 24 m from the pin, nowhere near the 300 m ceiling, and was stationary at 0.0 kph, below the 15 kph motion threshold. The arrival marker is true and the waiting clock was correctly started from the first in-geofence fix under POL-NS-02.

There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06: the effective in-geofence dwell is 330 seconds against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE, a surplus of 30 seconds recorded as shortfall_sec of -30. POL-NS-06's refund route is therefore not engaged and the cancellation fee is not refundable on that ground.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. Limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message from the rider during the waiting window, and the chat log contains none: only a SYSTEM 'Your driver has arrived' notice and the driver's own 'Waiting at PLQ 3 pickup bay.' Limb (c) fails as well, because the rider track places the rider's device about 519 m from the pin, well outside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged. That clause decides a driver who waited outside the arrival radius but within 400 m; here every fix is inside the 120 m radius, so there is no wrong-entrance case. trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill branch does not arise either.

On the merits POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of the itemised cancellation fee, SGD 3.20 of SGD 4.00, where the anti-farming check does not trip. The fare line itself reconciles: the LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee both resolve to SGD 4.00 under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect for anyone to exploit.

I do not dispute the anti-farming arithmetic in POL-NS-07, because the numbers on the citable fields are what they are: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 7, which is 4 or more, and 7 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate threshold. Both limbs of the check are met, so compensation is withheld and the matter escalates under POL-NS-09(d). The consequence under POL-NS-09 and POL-GEN-03 is that the disputed SGD 4.00 is placed on hold rather than collected or refunded, so escalation is not a refund to the rider and the rider's claim is not made out at this stage.

The rider asks for a pattern review, so it is worth recording what the citable counters actually show: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so neither rider-side limb of POL-NS-09(c) or (d) fires. The rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure is context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day counter.

The driver does not rely on POL-NS-06 limb (i), the only route that would need a traffic advisory in order to accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals, because the dwell here is one continuous run and no accumulation is required. For completeness and full disclosure, EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and supplies no fact to either side.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 4.00 no-show fee was validly incurred on the merits, so the waiting-period argument does not win you a refund — but your pattern concern is exactly what sends this case to a human reviewer. To the driver: all four conditions for the fee are met on clean evidence, but your own 30-day record bars your compensation here, and the case escalates.

On the merits, POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full: (a) the trip record carries your 'arrived' event at 09:30:20; (b) the GPS trace puts you inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from your first fix at 09:30:00, twenty seconds earlier; (c) you held the bay for one continuous 330-second run against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap, so the twenty-second gap costs you nothing; and (d) the trip was ended by you at 09:35:30 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed, with no boarding. No rider-side clause displaces the fee: you were inside the arrival radius, so POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not engaged; you were stationary 24 m from the pin at the tap, so POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) is not engaged; the rider sent no locating or coordinating message and her device sat about 519 m from the pin, so POL-NS-04 does not apply; and the dwell exceeded the minimum, so POL-NS-06's shortfall route gives the rider nothing. The recorded shortfall of −30 seconds confirms the surplus.

What changes the outcome is POL-NS-07's anti-farming check. Compensation of 80 percent of the fee (SGD 3.20) is withheld where the driver has 4 or more no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days AND that count divided by completed trips exceeds 0.08. Both limbs are met — 7 terminations against 70 completed trips, a rate of 0.10. Compensation is therefore withheld and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d).

Because escalation is terminal, the automated pipeline issues no monetary ruling: the SGD 4.00 is placed on hold, neither collected from the rider nor refunded, until a human reviewer decides. The rider's claim for a full refund is not granted by this ruling; the refund is directed into the escalation packet instead, where POL-NS-07 requires the reviewer to be instructed to refund the rider in full. The sum is SGD 4.00, being the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, and it reconciles with the fare breakdown, so there is no billing-integrity defect.

On the points both sides raised together: the lifetime counters (rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags, driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not substituted for the trailing-window fields; the rider-side escalation limbs are not triggered, since no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and the counterparty-dispute counts are 0 on both profiles; and the only impaired artifact, the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09108-01 (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), is relied on by nobody — no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed because the dwell was a single continuous run — so it does not move the outcome. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): the trace is complete and gapless, the chat log matches the trip record's message count, the clock is aligned, and the fare line reconciles. The deciding facts are carried at full weight (1.0), so confidence is 0.9.
